title: Dangerous goods (hazmat)
description: Dangerous-goods declaration anchored to the UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods (the "Orange Book"), as implemented by ADR (road), IMDG (sea), and IATA-DGR (air). Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when the goods are regulated dangerous goods. Carries the UN number, the official proper shipping name, the UN hazard class, and the packing group. The external standard is the source of truth; this clause references it.

fields.name: unNumber
fields.label: UN number
fields.description: Four-digit UN number assigned by the UN Committee of Experts, prefixed "UN" (e.g. UN1203 for petrol/gasoline).

fields.name: properShippingName
fields.label: Proper shipping name
fields.description: Official UN proper shipping name for the substance, as listed in the UN Dangerous Goods List.

fields.name: hazardClass
fields.label: UN hazard class
fields.description: UN hazard class (1–9) per the UN Recommendations. Divisions (e.g. 2.1) are carried in the proper shipping name where applicable.

fields.name: packingGroup
fields.label: Packing group
fields.description: UN packing group indicating degree of danger. Optional — classes 1, 2, and 7 are not assigned a packing group.
